official.title: Seasonal Climate Outlook
official.english_core_text: The rainfall forecast for the JFM season is predicted to be near- to above-normal over most parts of the country, aside from below-normal rainfall conditions over some areas in western Luzon. Central, Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines 1100 Website: http://bagong.pagasa.dost.gov.ph Forecast rainfall for this season suggests generally near-normal conditions over most parts of the country, aside from below-normal conditions in some areas of the Ilocos region and the western portions of Central Luzon and CALABARZON. Likewise, the probabilistic forecast indicates a moderate to high chance of above- normal rainfall conditions in most areas of the country. April to June (AMJ) 2026 Outlook Transition from La Niña to ENSO-neutral conditions is anticipated during the season.

official.title: Monthly Climate Assessment and Outlook
official.english_core_text: El Niño increases the likelihood of below normal rainfall conditions, which may result in adverse impacts such as dry spells and droughts in some areas of the country. Further, based on the said rainfall assessment, fifteen (15) provinces in Luzon experienced meteorological drought; thirty (30) provinces were under dry spells, and twenty-nine (29) provinces experienced dry conditions. This month, below normal rainfall conditions are expected over northern Luzon, western section of Central Luzon; above normal rainfall over central and eastern Visayas, and western Mindanao; and near normal rainfall over the rest of the country. Meanwhile, pockets of below normal rainfall were observed in the Cordilleras, Central Luzon, Bicol, Palawan, eastern Visayas, the Zamboanga Peninsula, Caraga, and the Davao region; while above normal rainfall in Camarines Sur.
official.中文核心观点: 出现 way below normal rainfall 表述，说明部分地区降雨显著低于常年，是Drought/Dry spell判断中的强信号。；官方文件涉及 dry condition / dry spell / drought，请优先核对省份名单与椰子产区重合度。；文件包含未来气候展望，可与本看板未来7/16天预测一起判断是否缓解。；文件涉及 ENSO / El Niño 背景，可能提高未来阶段性偏干概率。
